title: Hello,
description:
Hello,

This merge request makes this package build with the experimental cargo-auditable support introduced in rustc-1.93. This means all binary artifacts will have a JSON manifest embedded of all the dependencies used to build it.

The substantive changes were applied here: [1] and were approved here: [2]. This MR simply turns on the flag that rustc listens to.

It builds in a PPA here: [3] and passes autopkgtests here: [4].

[1]: https://git.launchpad.net/~maxgmr/ubuntu/+source/rustc/commit/?h=merge-1.93&id=bb5c8e7bab37ccb3e8a5998e033c00c9865baa7f
NB at time of writing, cgit is down, so you need to use the VPN to view the patch.
[2]: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+bug/2138660
[3]: https://launchpad.net/~petrakat/+archive/ubuntu/cargo-auditable-prod-test/+packages
[4]: https://autopkgtest.ubuntu.com/results/autopkgtest-resolute-petrakat-cargo-auditable-prod-test/resolute/amd64/r/rust-sudo-rs/20260320_203832_54fbf@/log.gz
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 5f535ab..009baf5 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,9 @@
+rust-sudo-rs (0.2.12-0ubuntu2) resolute; urgency=medium
+
+  * Add cargo-auditable metadata
+
+ -- Petrichor Park <petrichor.park@canonical.com>  Fri, 20 Mar 2026 09:15:48 -0500
+
 rust-sudo-rs (0.2.12-0ubuntu1) resolute; urgency=medium
 
   * New upstream version (LP: #2141927)
diff --git a/debian/control b/debian/control
index 27ab253..45fc1fc 100644
--- a/debian/control
+++ b/debian/control
@@ -4,7 +4,8 @@ Priority: optional
 Build-Depends: debhelper-compat (= 13),
                dh-sequence-cargo,
                libpam-dev,
-               pandoc [!i386]
+               pandoc [!i386],
+			   cargo-auditable
 Build-Depends-Arch: cargo:native, libstd-rust-dev, rustc:native (>= 1.70)
 XS-Vendored-Sources-Rust: glob@0.3.3, libc@0.2.180
 Maintainer: Ubuntu Developers <ubuntu-devel-discuss@lists.ubuntu.com>
diff --git a/debian/rules b/debian/rules
index 5989fb2..a893057 100755
--- a/debian/rules
+++ b/debian/rules
@@ -1,4 +1,5 @@
 #!/usr/bin/make -f
+export UBUNTU_ENABLE_CARGO_AUDITABLE=1
 
 UPSTREAM_VERSION := $(shell dpkg-parsechangelog -S Version|cut -d- -f1)
